posts.zh:
dsh-agentmail 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。用 AgentMail 给 agent 配一个自己的收件箱：发信、读信、搜索与打标签共十一个工具；收到的邮件按邮件线程分派，每个线程对应一个独立会话；所有外发邮件都要过审批与收件人白名单。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-dff8f98a11d2d2342c70.html
posts.en:
dsh-agentmail is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Gives an agent its own email inbox through AgentMail — eleven tools for sending, reading and labelling mail, plus inbound mail delivered into one harness session per email thread, with an approval gate and recipient allowlist on everything outbound.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-dff8f98a11d2d2342c70.html
